description:
Redaction pass that runs on every outbound submission before it leaves the machine. Scrubs: environment variables, file paths that include usernames, tokens/keys matching standard patterns, email addresses, and any content stored in secrets-manager. Fails closed — if the scrubber can't confidently classify a chunk, the submission blocks with a diff for user review.

Leans on secrets-manager for the secret-pattern registry. Includes a test corpus of realistic bug-report content (stack traces, log excerpts, file paths) to verify scrub behavior without over-redacting.
name: contribution-scrubber
title: Build PII/secrets scrubber for outbound submissions
